english.title: Fail to comply with notice given under section 790D to person with significant control

english.legislation: Contrary to section 790D of, and paragraph 13 of Schedule 1B to, the Companies Act 2006.

english.notes: This offence is no longer in force from 18/11/2025. Section 790D was substituted for new sections 790CB, 790D, 790DA, 790E, 790EA, 790EB and 790EC by the Economic Crime and Corporate Transparency Act 2023 from 18/11/2025. This introduced a new statutory scheme for the company duties in relation to registerable people and legal entities. Failure to perform the duties contained within the legislation are offences under section 790F.

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: maximum 6/12 months imprisonment and/or a fine.
Indictment: maximum 2 years imprisonment and/or a fine.

The maximum penalty on summary conviction may be 6 or 12 months depending on the general limit in a magistrates’ court, see section 224(1) and (1A) of the Sentencing Act 2022.
Time limit for prosecutions: None
